scope: 98 enabled literal buttons reported in digital/module/src/index.html; excludes dynamic controls and main app skipped by the static auditor
method: One-to-one line-count reconciliation, source handler/loop mapping, real Chromium CDP DOMDebugger.getEventListeners after visiting Notes and Labs, and bounded representative behavior checks. No fake inline handlers or auditor rule changes.

behaviorChecks.name: Native net-mode disclosure reaches the existing editor action
Net clear changes the real editor grid
Native lab-camera disclosure exposes real directional control
Unit Add and Clear mutate the real unit count
Comparison Add uses the existing capacity model
Explore zoom and reset change the actual model camera
Views button switches the actual orthographic mode
Measurements calculate canonical current values and reset validation
Focus and theme buttons change their actual document presentation state
